title: Prachin Bharat ke Samvat
hook: Prachin Bharat ke Samvat: Shaka Samvat 1957 se Bharat ka rashtriya panchang (1 Chaitra = 22 March).
exam_points: Shaka Samvat 1957 se Bharat ka rashtriya panchang (1 Chaitra = 22 March).
Vikram Samvat ki shuruat 57 BCE se maani jati hai (Malwa parampara).

mcqs.q: Vikram Samvat kis varsh se shuru mana jata hai?
